'''Torwyn Redbrand''' is a [[dwarf]] [[quest ender]] located in the [[Mystic Ward]] in [[Ironforge]]. A historian for the [[Redbrand family]], he has made it his life's goal to complete his family's lineage.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|28|The Redbrand Lie (2)|The Redbrand Lie}}</ref>

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|32|The Redbrand Archive}} {{questfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|28|The Redbrand Lie (2)|The Redbrand Lie}} {{questfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Ours is a rich history, full of distinction and honor. We once served as the right hand to the Bronzebeards, but there have been many unfortunate incidents within the past few generations.

I have been looking for assistance in collecting a number of our lost chronicles. Perhaps you could be of help?
